rationale: Cyber-attack on European shop infrastructure affects Portugal as EU member; migrant deaths near Canary Islands directly impact Iberian maritime zone; EU-wide security concerns raised.

top_events.title: Shop freezers in seven European countries hit by cyber-attack
top_events.label: Cyber-attack hits shop freezers across Europe
top_events.summary: Coordinated cyber-attack causes freezers to reach 50C in seven EU countries. Infrastructure vulnerability affecting Portugal and European food supply chain.

top_events.title: At least seven migrants die on boat bound for Canary Islands amid storm
top_events.label: Seven migrants die en route to Canary Islands
top_events.summary: Storm kills at least seven of 139 migrants on boat to Canary Islands. Tragedy in Atlantic waters near Portuguese maritime zone.

top_events.title: Ryanair says it may freeze workers' pay and raise airfares
top_events.label: Ryanair may freeze pay and raise fares
top_events.summary: Major airline warns of €2bn fuel cost increase by 2028 due to US-Israel-Iran war, threatening pay freeze and fare hikes affecting Portuguese travelers.
